This page contains a summary of the labs completed for E155.

## Lab 1 - Board Assembly and Testing

### Overview

For this lab I assembled the E155 board and tested it. After soldering all the components on, I programmed 
a 7 segment display to show hexadecimal digits taking four switches as binary inputs. Also blinked an LED 
using the Updunio's internal HSOSC oscillator. 


### Design

There were two important considerations for the design of this project. The first was the resistor values to use 
for the seven segment display.
